patterns.note: Content is primarily centered with generous vertical spacing, creating an airy and editorial feel, often overlaying full-bleed background imagery.
A highly decorative, elegant serif font is used for all major headings, contrasting with a clean, simple sans-serif for body text and functional elements.
The palette is predominantly monochromatic black and white, with subtle warm off-white tones introduced through evocative, often desaturated, background photography.
The hero section features a large, animated text element that distorts and disappears on scroll, accompanied by small, parallaxing window-like images that also fade out.
Key content sections, like 'Notre Vision', are presented as white, semi-transparent cards positioned centrally over full-bleed background images.

technique_notes: The hero text employs a Lottie animation that dynamically distorts and scales out of view as the user scrolls down the page, creating a dramatic reveal of the subsequent content.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, often appearing over fixed or subtly parallaxing full-bleed background images.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, decorative serif headings (~3-5x body text) with generous letter-spacing, paired with a legible, well-spaced sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including content cards and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical whitespace between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly stylized, animated serif typography in the hero section, combined with a minimalist, editorial layout and evocative travel imagery, creates a unique sense of luxury and sophistication that avoids generic templates.
